**Needs changes before merge.** Not built on this head (see "Results").

Review tier: SAFETY. The PR changes toolpath generation: with `equal_steps` on, the cut levels of each 2D and 3D ladder move.

### What looks good

- The default ladder is not changed. `cut_levels_for` with a default approach calls `cut_levels_under` with the same stepdown, so no golden moves. `git diff --stat` for `*.nc`, `*.cl` and `*.cnc` is empty.
- One level law stays. `equal_stepdown` only gives a different stepdown to `cut_levels_under`. The refusals (stepdown not positive, not finite, more than `MAX_PASSES`) keep the user's number.
- `equal_stepdown` has no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!`. A bad span or stepdown comes back unchanged, and the level law refuses it.
- Each `cut_levels_under` call that reads `links.approach` on `upstream/main` 3ffe2338f goes through the mode. The calls that stay (Face, Trochoidal Slot, `slots.rs:347`) read no `links` object, as the body says. Main added no new call after the merge base.
- The app region law (`area.rs`, `boundary_ctx.rs`) reads the same mode through `OpParams::ladder_stepdown`, on the same span as the generator.
- The 3-D readers of `stepdown` as a bound (`level_ctx.rs:81` shell tip floor, `level_ctx.rs:289` bore band) read a bound that is equal to or larger than the real step. The shell tip still obeys the part field. The bore check becomes more conservative. I agree with item 5 of the decision file: this is the safe side.
- The project file writes the key only when it is on. The digest adds one byte only when it is on. The stamps of existing operations do not change.
- The parameter goes through `EditOperationParams` and the MCP `edit_operation` patch. No new command is necessary.
- The decision file is complete. The new module has a provenance line. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #2012`.

### Results

- Trial merge with `upstream/main` 3ffe2338f: **conflict in code**, `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_avoid.rs`. Main commit 69ff095a5 (`feat(2d): add dogbone and t-bone corner relief for pockets`) changed the same `use super::levels::{...}` import line. The resolution looks small, but it is in code. Thus I did not merge, and I reviewed the PR head only.
- Build and tests: **not built**. The shared sccache server on the review machine did not answer. Each `cargo` call stopped at the first crates with no CPU use, for more than 10 minutes. I could not change the build environment in this run. Thus I ran no suite, no clippy and no mutation. This is not a pass.
- Mutations: **not run again**. The body reports three mutations, each red and then green again. A SAFETY review must run two of them again. The next review of a new head must do this.
- Extra suites run: none. The diff changes no `testdata/` file and no import code, so no extra suite applies.

### Requested before merge

1. **Merge conflict.** Merge `upstream/main` into the branch (no rebase, no force-push). In `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_avoid.rs`, keep the new imports of main (`corner_relief`, `corner_relief_spur`, `non_sliver_center`, `pocket_entered_with_relief`) and the `cut_levels_for` import of the PR. Remove `cut_levels_under` from the `levels` import. Make sure that `pocket_avoid_with_relief` (from main) calls `cut_levels_for`. Then run the quick gate again on the merged head.
2. **UI screenshots.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/lead_page.rs:120-122` adds the row "Equal depth steps" and its hint to the Linking group of the Lead in / Lead out tab. The PR body has no before and after screenshots of that tab. Put them on the images-only `pr-screenshots` branch of the fork and link them from the body. Do not commit them to the PR branch.
3. **Gate on the final head.** The body says that the full quick gate ran on `6ba261db2`, not on the head `13c4dffab`. After item 1, give the quick gate result on the merged head, with the pinning tests named. Run `ui suites: lib` again too: it stopped with SIGSEGV one time in the earlier run (#2807).

### Questions and notes (not blocking)

- Formatting: eight `cut_levels_for(...)` calls have no space after the comma before the bottom argument (`&p.links.approach,p.bottom_z`): `adaptive_troch.rs:157`, `bore.rs:308`, `circular.rs:280`, `circular.rs:290`, `contour_params.rs:224`, `pocket_hsm.rs:52`, `pocket_troch.rs:68`, `slots.rs:160`. Also `equal_steps.rs:35` has `{equal_stepdown(` with no space. `cargo fmt` on the touched files corrects these.
- `crates/motion/src/approach.rs` is now 446 lines (it was 440). `crates/motion/src/machining3d/entry.rs` is now 402 lines. A split along a domain seam can come in a follow-up.
- #2678 replaces the same `cut_levels_under` calls in `machining3d/entry.rs`. The PR that merges second must keep the ladder mode in the 3-D ladder, as the body says.
- This is a `feat`. By the Pull Request Law, it merges at the next minor cut.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Merge conflict: merged upstream/main at 81407b31b. Both import sets stay. The relief pocket uses cut_levels_for.
   Pin: `a_pocket_with_keepouts_and_relief_cuts_the_levels_of_its_mode`.
   Bypass the ladder mode: RED. Suppress relief: RED. Restore each change: GREEN.
   The law mutation also gives 11 RED pins. Restore: all 12 motion pins GREEN.
2. UI screenshots: the body links the before and after tab images on the fork's images-only pr-screenshots branch.
   The before image removes only the new row from the same merged scene.
   A temporary CPU renderer draws the real egui output. The environment has no WGPU adapter.
   No images or capture helpers are in this branch.
3. Final-head gate: ran `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`. Result: RED, 163 of 164 steps pass.
   Both motion and app equal_steps suites pass. The UI library step has 1,278 passed, seven failed and seven ignored.
   Each failure reports `No adapter found`: six report capture tests and `headless_run_succeeds`.
   The explicit UI library rerun gives the same result. Neither run has a SIGSEGV.
   Clippy on motion, app and UI with all targets and `-D warnings`: GREEN.

New head: db53a0a827db8d3a59b518e1960f1f862198e0cd.

Please re-review this head. The UI library gate still needs a run with a WGPU adapter.

Needs changes before merge: two validation items remain.

Review tier: SAFETY. The parameter changes the cut depths of toolpaths when it is on.

### What looks good

- The trial merge with current `upstream/main` (`a36d4e8e8`) is clean. The earlier import conflict is fixed. The pocket keeps both the ladder mode and corner relief.
- The body now has before and after screenshots. I opened both images. Their commit is the head of the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.
- The default ladder still calls the existing level law with the original stepdown. No G-code, CL, fixture or golden file changes. There are no moved goldens to check line by line.
- The project DTO omits the new field when it is off. The digest includes the field when it is on. The parameter uses the existing undoable command and MCP patch.
- The app tests pass for undo, redo, persistence, digest changes, region stepdown, generated contour levels and MCP edits.
- The new module has a provenance comment. The decision file records the default, alternatives and excluded operation types.

### Local results

All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2842`. The tested tree includes a local trial merge with `a36d4e8e8`. No GitHub runner was used. I disabled sccache with `RUSTC_WRAPPER=` and `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: **163 of 164 steps passed**, in 25.8 minutes. All three test builds passed.

| Selected suites | Test targets | Passed tests | Failed tests | Ignored tests |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| motion | 70 | 1,046 | 0 | 54 |
| app | 83 | 998 | 0 | 18 |
| UI | 8 | 1,314 | 7 | 7 |

The new `motion:equal_steps` suite passed all 12 tests. The new `app:equal_steps` suite passed all six tests.

The only failed step was `ui suites: lib`: 1,278 passed, seven failed, seven ignored. I ran `cargo test -j 16 -p camcraft-ui --lib` again from `crates/ui`. It gave the same counts. Both runs completed without SIGSEGV.

Six failures are in `egui_app::report_tests`:

- `a_kind_button_asks_the_shell_for_the_whole_window`
- `no_answer_copies_nothing`
- `the_answer_copies_the_picture_and_says_the_word`
- `the_door_opens_the_window_and_a_kind_button_files_the_url`
- `the_picture_is_still_copied_after_the_window_is_closed`
- `the_title_field_travels_into_the_url`

The seventh is `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`. The failures report:

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
```

The headless test also reports that Metal found no adapters. These failures show an environment limit. They do not establish a regression in this PR.

`cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: **passed**.

### Mutations run by this reviewer

1. Make `ladder_stepdown` ignore `equal_steps`. **RED**: 11 motion tests fail; the refusal test passes. Restore the source: **GREEN**, all 12 tests pass.
2. Make `pocket_avoid_with_relief` call `cut_levels_under` directly. **RED**: `a_pocket_with_keepouts_and_relief_cuts_the_levels_of_its_mode` fails. It finds `[15, 10, 5, 2]` instead of `[15.5, 11, 6.5, 2]`. Restore the source: **GREEN**, all 12 tests pass.

All temporary edits were restored. The trial worktree is clean. No evidence or image was committed or pushed.

### Extra suites run

None required by the extra selection rules. The diff changes no test fixture, golden, `testdata/` file or importer code.

Heavy lanes: **not run**. I ran `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`. It selects all motion and app heavy targets, with 233 planned steps. A dry run is not a pass.

### Requested before merge

1. `crates/motion/src/machining3d/entry.rs:121`: supply the required heavy-lane results. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, **Heavy lanes at review**, requires each reached heavy test to run. The PR body explicitly says that none ran. Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final head. Record the results and correct any unexpected failure.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/lead_page.rs:121`: complete UI validation on a local machine with a working graphics adapter. Both local UI library runs still fail seven tests. Record a passing run on the final head. The screenshots meet the earlier screenshot request, but they do not replace the UI test run.

The earlier conflict and screenshot findings are met. The quick gate and explicit UI rerun now have results on this head. The passing UI result remains missing.

This is a `feat`; it merges at the next minor cut. The existing file-length and formatting notes remain nonblocking.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Heavy-lane execution: ran `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the unchanged final head. Result: RED, 232 of 233 steps pass.
   Motion has 56 passing heavy tests. App has 40 passing tests and one failure. Nine known-fail checks pass.
   Pin: `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` in `app:pocket3d_hsm`.
   The path count assertion fails with `(3158, 3130, 1141)`.
   Remove all PR motion/app source changes: the exact pin fails with the same counts.
   Restore the source: the exact pin fails with the same counts. The worktree is clean.
   This platform count failure predates this PR. The test already identifies the unmeasured macOS range with #2371.
2. UI validation: both the quick gate and the explicit local UI library run still fail seven graphics tests.
   Each library run has 1,278 passed, seven failed and seven ignored. All failures report `No adapter found`.
   Neither run has a SIGSEGV. This process finds no Metal adapter. The requested passing graphics run remains blocked.

Quick gate: RED, 163 of 164 steps pass. All 12 motion and six app `equal_steps` pins pass.
Clippy on motion, app and UI, all targets with warnings denied: GREEN.
The PR body now records these results. No source changes or new pins were needed for these validation findings.
No screenshots, logs, evidence files or process version changes were committed.

Head unchanged: db53a0a827db8d3a59b518e1960f1f862198e0cd.

Please re-review this evidence. The heavy count failure and the passing graphics validation remain unresolved.

The maintainer ordered a clear-out of the PRs with `needs-rework` or `conflicts`: each one is repaired, reviewed and merged. This PR had a push in the last 6 hours, so the coordinator session of NeoTech does not edit its branch now. Push a refresh, or say here that you keep it. After 6 hours without a push or an answer, our session takes the PR over on this branch (a merge of `main`, never a rebase or a force-push) and repairs the open review items.

Please fix ASAP.

This PR has the label `needs-rework`. The open items are in the latest review comment on this PR. Push a fix, or say that you keep this PR. The maintainer asked for this reminder.
